item.title: Trump Calls on Alaskans to Repeal Ranked-Choice Voting
item.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday urged Alaskans to repeal ranked-choice voting in November, asking in a Truth Social post how foolish it would be to continue the system.

item.title: House Democrats Seek $17 Million in Urgent Fundraising Push
item.description: The campaign arm of House Democrats said it needs $17 million immediately.

item.title: Workers Protest DC Plan to Allow Robotaxis on City Streets
item.description: Protesters gathered outside D.C.'s John Wilson Building as council members considered legislation to permit Waymo robotaxis on Washington streets.
